summary.plain: The team of scientists, including the group at UW-Madison's IceCube centre, who built and continue to run the ARA radio-antenna stations near the South Pole.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the Askaryan Radio Array near the South Pole; WIPAC (University of Wisconsin-Madison) is a named lead institution for field operations; no published total membership count found this session.
